description: Settings-window permissions. Everything here is Settings-side: the updater, `process` (relaunch after install), the native dialog plugin (the update prompt) and `notification`. Scoped to `setup` alone since #195 — the second entry this list used to carry named a window label that the multi-window refactor retired, so it matched nothing while reading as if dialog windows were permissioned. Dialog windows are covered by `dialog.json`.
